description: Every canonical decision made during the V20 consolidation process. Records what changed, why, and when.

decisions.change: adult_status field removed from Character schema
decisions.reason: Age and verification handled at platform layer, not in character data.

decisions.change: Chandra-Kala linked to Ritu Kala as biological rhythm tracker
decisions.reason: Classical Ayurvedic linkage; never a consent override.
Added DRASHTA_RATI as the 98th kama, filling a genuine gap for observer pleasure.

decisions.change: Family H frozen at 10 visible entries plus DRASHTA_RATI
decisions.reason: 7 original entries not recoverable from source. Provenance rules forbid fabrication.

decisions.change: Removed spurious LAGHAVA_KALA entry from matrix
decisions.reason: LAGHAVA_KALA is not a classical Kala. Correct art is hasta-laghava, absorbed into Domain 2.

decisions.change: Padmā set as co-primary on Kalas 58 and 59
decisions.reason: Aligns with her service/culinary role. Co-primary with Malika.

decisions.change: Fixed character_dimension_weights.json and reduced dims from 21 to 20
decisions.reason: File had two root objects; 'nurture' dimension folded into 'devotion'.

decisions.change: DRASHTA_RATI added as 98th kama in Family H
decisions.reason: Fills observer-pleasure gap not covered by BUST_EXHIBITIONISM or DACRYPHILIA.
